the role of heparan sulfates in development.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Pipe is a heparan sulfate sulfotransferase with an unusual substrate specificity.

Pipe activity is required to generate the correct composition of heparan sulfates in the eggshell matrix, but the precise nature of the Pipe substrate remains unknown.
